Original Law.Subject: Creation of a Committee on Property Inspection
Original Law.Details:
To safeguard and protect the interest of this Bureau in the matter of purchases of supplies, materials, equipment and other items made by the Property Division or any other BIR Office or unit, there is hereby created a COMMITTEE ON PROPERTY INSPECTION to be composed of the following: cdphil

Inspection of Deliveries

1. It is the primary responsibility of the Committee to recommend the acceptance or rejection of any and all deliveries of supplies, materials, equipment and other items made by suppliers, contractors, or dealers to the BIR.

2. The Committee shall see to it that the articles or items submitted for inspection were acquired in accordance with law and regulation governing purchases, that they conform to government specifications and standardization and that the quantity is not in excess of actual needs.

3. Supplies, materials, equipment or other items delivered for operation or public relation use and those used for the improvement or repair and maintenance of property and government facilities should be inspected by the Committee before they are actually used or issued. The inspection should be made invariably at the place of delivery and not elsewhere so as to insure that the articles inspected are the ones delivered to prevent any possible substitution.

4. Projects in which supplies and materials delivered are used should be inspected by the Committee from time to time and under no circumstance should final payment be allowed unless an ocular inspection of the project or work has been made by the Committee.

5. Evidence of inspection of deliveries of insignificant value not exceeding P50 for drugs or chemicals and P100 for other supplies and materials must be shown by notation on the originals of the order and the invoice. Other than those however, report of inspection of delivery must be submitted to the Chief, Property Division, copy furnished the Chief, Fiscal Audit Division and the Revenue Operations Head (Administrative Services).

6. If practicable, the Committee shall conduct its inspection of deliveries simultaneously with that of the Auditor or his representative.

7. It is the responsibility of the Chief, Property Division to notify the Chairman, Committee on Property Inspection of any and all deliveries made and to be inspected. cdtai

This Order takes effect immediately.

MISAEL P. VERA
Commissioner of Internal Revenue

Original Law.Subject: Creation of the Committee on Incentive Award
Original Law.Details:
In line with the policy enunciated in Section 27 of Republic Act 2260, otherwise known as the Civil Service Act of 1959, calling for the establishment by the Civil Service Commission of a government-wide "Employees Suggestions and Incentive Award System", there is hereby created an Awards Committee in the Bureau of Internal Revenue composed of the following, viz: cdphil

The committee as comprised above shall recommend to the Commissioner of Internal Revenue, the officials and/or employees of the Bureau of Internal Revenue who may be entitled to the Incentive Awards based on the following:

I. Bases of Awards:

1. Efficiency;

2. Punctuality;

3. For giving suggestions that save time, money and effort;

4. For the province with the most assessments;

5. For the province with the biggest collection;

6. For the province which has consistently submitted reports of collection and made remittances of collection on time;

7. For the Regional Office which has the least number of delinquent accounts;

8. For individual fieldman who has the greater number of newly discovered taxpayers.

II. Persons Entitled to the Awards:

1. Janitors

2. Clerks

3. Regional Directors, Chiefs of divisions, Provincial Revenue Officers, and Chiefs of branches, etc.

III. Kinds of Awards:

1. Letter of commendation

2. Plaque

3. Bonuses of efficiency ratings

4. Promotions

5. Certificates of merit

6. Sending abroad for special studies

7. Medals

8. Awarding of books on Management and Taxation

9. Scholarships

10. Tour of regional offices

IV. Occasion when the award is to be given:

1. Christmas time

2. Anniversary day of the BIR

The committee should submit the names of those who are entitled to awards at least one month before the giving of the awards to the Commissioner of Internal Revenue for final approval. LLjur

(SGD.) JOSE B. LINGAD
Acting Commissioner of Internal Revenue
